- 20 @keyframes noted in readable stylesheets. Keep the names, steps, and curves below:
```css
@keyframes shimmer { 
  100% { transform: translate(100%); }
}
@keyframes pill-edge-glow { 
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: rgba(15, 21, 29, 0.4) 0px 8px 20px -8px; }
  50% { box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 0px 20px 2px, rgba(15, 21, 29, 0.4) 0px 8px 20px -8px; }
}
@keyframes social-proof-gradient-float { 
  0% { background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(255, 249, 246) 0px, rgb(255, 249, 246) 40px, rgb(255, 141, 105) calc(100% - 190px), rgb(255, 141, 105) 100%); }
  25% { background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(255, 249, 246) 0px, rgb(255, 249, 246) 55px, rgb(255, 141, 105) calc(100% - 215px), rgb(255, 141, 105) 100%); }

@keyframes illus-float { 
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(170px) rotate(-2deg) translateY(0px); }
  50% { transform: translate(170px) rotate(-2deg) translateY(-12px); }
}
@keyframes hero-fade-up { 
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}
@keyframes intro-blob-warm { 
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0px); }
  50% { transform: translate(60px, 40px); }
}
@keyframes intro-blob-cool { 
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0px); }
  50% { transform: translate(-50px, -30px); }
}
@keyframes intro-logo-in { 
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}
```
